p1: You know the legend. A truck flashes its high beams to warn you about the man in your back seat.
Last night, it happened to me.
Leaving the diner, something thumped on my roof. I figured it was a branch.
Ten minutes later, a truck pulled up behind me. Flash. Flash. Flash.
So I did what the story says. I checked the back seat.
I pulled into a gas station, and the trucker ran over, waving his arms.
I told him, relax. There's no one in my car.
He went white and whispered... Not in it. On it.
Then, right above my head, the sunroof slid open.
Follow. And always check your roof.
